correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the 2n-vertex Möbius ladder is cubic. Double-count D-to-complement edges to get |D|>=n. With rung counts x zero, y singleton, z full, |D|=n+z-x. The three-neighbor local rules exclude mixed zero and singleton blocks when |D|<=n+1; the remaining singleton/full case forces one full rung and yields 2n configurations, while zero/full cyclic run lengths 1..2 for zeros and >=2 for fulls force 0033 periodicity or a unique defect. These give gamma=n for n divisible by 4 and gamma=n+1 otherwise, with exact counts 4,2n,3n. Independent direct labeled-vertex exhaustive enumeration for all n=3..9 reproduces 9,4,15,12,21,4,27 minima. The finite enumeration cannot prove the unbounded classification.
